<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs. Edit the repository definition and its Markdown documentation. -->

Append a detached verity hash tree to a data image.

## Inputs

| Name        | Kind | Description                                         |
| ----------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`     | file | Original data image authenticated by the hash tree. |
| `hash-tree` | file | Detached verity image including its superblock.     |

## Parameters

| Name        | Default | Description                                                                                |
| ----------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `alignment` | `4096`  | Power-of-two byte alignment of the hash area, at least 512. Must suit the hash block size. |

## Outputs

| Name          | Kind | Description                                                                  |
| ------------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`       | file | Data image followed by alignment padding and the verity hash image.          |
| `hash-offset` | file | Hash-area byte offset as decimal text.                                       |
| `data-size`   | file | Original data length in bytes as decimal text, excluding padding and hashes. |

## Execution

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Environment  | Rugix Bakery |
| Source epoch | Consumed     |
| Output cache | Allowed      |

## Behavior

Package a data image and its detached dm-verity hash tree in one artifact. The
combined image contains the original data, zero-filled alignment padding, and
the hash-tree image, including its verity superblock.

Supply a hash tree generated for the exact data image, for example with
`core/dm-verity`. Keep that rule's `root-hash` output for the authenticated boot
metadata. `alignment` defaults to 4096 bytes and must be a power of two of at
least 512 bytes that suits the hash block size.

| Output        | Contents                                                                     |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`       | Combined data and verity image                                               |
| `hash-offset` | Byte offset of the appended hash area, as decimal text                       |
| `data-size`   | Original data length in bytes, excluding padding and hashes, as decimal text |

The data image and hash tree must both be nonempty. A consuming boot flow must
authenticate the root hash and the geometry used to open the combined image.
`core/verified-cmdline` embeds the offset and data length in boot arguments for
the core verified-root contract.

## Example

For example, append authentication data to a prepared filesystem image:

```toml
uses = "core/append-verity"
inputs.image = { path = "system.squashfs" }
inputs.hash-tree = { path = "verity.img" }
```

Save the invocation as `build-rule.toml` and run
`./run-bakery bake rule build-rule.toml build/result`.
